name: Spectrum TV (Charter)
why: Largest U.S. cable TV provider (catalog approx 12.6M); national brand with its own My Spectrum billing site.

name: Xfinity TV (Comcast)
why: Second-largest U.S. pay-TV provider (catalog approx 12M); national brand, Xfinity account billing.

name: DIRECTV
why: Largest satellite TV provider (catalog approx 11.3M); national brand with its own billing site.

name: DISH
why: Second national satellite TV provider (catalog approx 5.5M); distinct my.dish.com billing.

name: Verizon Fios TV
why: Largest telco fiber TV service (catalog approx 2.8M); My Verizon home billing.

name: Optimum TV (Altice USA)
why: Major regional cable provider (catalog approx 1.9M); optimum.net billing.

name: Mediacom Xtream TV
why: Major Midwest/South cable provider (catalog approx 445K); own My Account billing.

name: Breezeline
why: Regional cable provider (Cogeco, catalog approx 280K) with its own billing and EcoSave AutoPay rules.

name: WOW! (WideOpenWest)
why: Recognizable regional cable TV brand with its own My Account billing.

name: Astound Broadband
why: Recognizable regional cable brand (RCN, Grande, Wave) with its own MyAstound billing. Cox (merged into Spectrum) skipped as a duplicate billing company; Frontier TV skipped (legacy, now Verizon).
